Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our side:

- Data residency / GDPR: We support EU regions and can sign standard DPA terms; we asked for any specific processing concerns you want called out.
- HIPAA: We have a BA option for Dedicated/Private deployments — happy to share the BA template.
- Pen test / vuln mgmt: You asked for our latest pen test report and an overview of our vulnerability management SLAs and scanning cadence.

Next steps we discussed:
1) I will send our latest redacted pen test report (or summary) and a filled vendor security questionnaire by EOD.
2) If you need the full report under an NDA we can coordinate — let me know preferred contact and format.
3) We will include our remediation SLAs (critical/high/medium/low) and scanning cadence (internal and external).

Do you want the pen test redaction to remove IP addresses and customer identifiers, or would a fully redacted executive summary be sufficient for initial review?

Thanks — talk soon.

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Executive summary redaction is fine for the initial review; if the InfoSec team needs more detail we will provide an NDA request. A few clarifying items from our side:

- For SOC 2, can you confirm the last test period (start/end) and whether the report includes the Redwood hosted API?

If possible, send the redacted report and the completed vendor security questionnaire (attached during the call) and we will route to our procurement and InfoSec.

Marissa —

We can share a redacted pen test executive summary and the vulnerability management doc. Notes below (I will attach the artifacts):

- Pen test: latest engagement Aug 2026. Executive summary redacted to remove IPs and usernames is fine. Full report requires an NDA and DLP review.
- Vulnerability management SLAs:
  - Critical: acknowledge within 24 hours, remediation plan within 72 hours, target mitigation or compensating control within 30 days
  - High: acknowledge within 72 hours, remediation plan within 7 days, target mitigation within 60 days
  - Medium: acknowledged within 7 days, remediation plan within 30 days
  - Low: scheduled on next regular release cycle (quarterly)
- Scanning cadence:
  - External black-box scan: monthly
  - Internal authenticated scans: weekly for production services
  - SAST/Dependency scans: nightly on CI with weekly triage
- Disclosure policy: coordinated disclosure; vendors get 90 days for non-critical issues, immediate disclosure for critical with joint communication plan.

Attachments I will add to this mail: redacted_pen_test_report_2026-08.pdf, vuln_mgmt_sla.docx, vendor_security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx
